parameters.text:
=Analyze this cybersecurity news article.

Title: {{ $json.title }}
Details: {{ $json.contentSnippet }}

Return:
- summary: ONE sentence (max 25 words) explaining why this matters and who is affected.
- severity: exactly one of Critical, High, Medium, Low
  (Critical = actively exploited or CVSS 9+; High = serious flaw or major breach, not yet exploited; Medium = limited impact or niche target; Low = research, policy or general news)
- category: exactly one of Vulnerability, Malware, Data Breach, Phishing, AI Security, Policy, Other

parameters.content:
# AI Cybersecurity Briefing
Every morning at 9 AM, fetches the latest cybersecurity news,
uses Gemini AI to summarize and rate each story's severity,
and emails a prioritized briefing.

# 1. Fetch new articles
RSS feed → skip articles already sent → keep the 5 newest

# 2. AI analysis
Gemini returns summary + severity + category as JSON.
Retry on fail + fallback model for reliability.
Merge joins each article with its analysis.

# 3. Format & send
Sort by severity → color-coded HTML cards → email
